blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The expanded Daniel Z. Romualdez (DZR) Airport in this city is targeted for completion by February 2027, ahead of the Holy Week travel season, as the national government seeks to improve passenger capacity and strengthen air connectivity in Eastern Visayas. Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez announced the target on Friday, Oct. 23, following an inspection of the ongoing airport rehabilitation and expansion project, which President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. has ordered accelerated to accommodate more travelers next year. “The president instructed us to accelerate the construction of Tacloban Airport so that more passengers and tourists can benefit from it […]...
